column1: # The shipping destination-class table (threat model section 10.5).
# One host per row, lowercase, no scheme and no port. This is the single
# committed authority read by both the sandboxed Rust policy engine and the
# browser-process dispatch guard. A row's class must name a SiteClass member,
# or either consumer's build refuses the whole table.
# This file is compiled in and is never fetched, patched, or overlaid at run
# time. Decision 0015 forbids catalog data from changing security policy, and
# this is security policy: a removable row would widen what the assistant may
# Membership, ownership, review cadence, and locale coverage are [Open
# (OD-081)]. The rows below are deliberately few and deliberately
# uncontroversial: this table ships as a mechanism with a small, honest seed,
# not as a claim to have enumerated the web.
# No host in this file may end in .test — that suffix belongs to the policy
# engine's fixture corpus table, and a test asserts the two never overlap.
